name: ferjani
description: Claude Code skills, guardrail hooks and mods by Khaled Ferjani

plugins.name: adr-template
plugins.description: Write or review ADRs that cover the hard parts: contracts, failure modes, observability, migration and rollback.

plugins.name: comment-cleanup
plugins.description: Tightens the code comments in a reviewed diff against your project's comment policy, as the tail of a code review.

plugins.name: context-hud
plugins.description: Context window and plan usage limits at a glance: footer gauges, a per-category pane, and a warning past a threshold

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Shows context size and session cost in the status line, and warns once when the context passes a threshold

plugins.name: dependabot-handle
plugins.description: Triage open Dependabot PRs: merge clean green bumps, close failing ones with a short reason, skip the rest.

plugins.name: format-on-edit
plugins.description: Formats and lints each file Claude writes or edits with the tools the project already has.

plugins.name: gardener
plugins.description: Weekly upkeep of your Claude Code setup: acceptance metric, mistakes turned into checks, broken hooks and skills, repo drift.

plugins.name: gh-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Claude from posting GitHub comments or reviews as you until you give an explicit go

plugins.name: github-work
plugins.description: Works through the open GitHub issues assigned to you one at a time, with review and test agents and one PR per issue.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Denies merges, closes, secret reads, container teardown and shell rewrites of tracked files until you give the go.

plugins.name: issues-workflow
plugins.description: Fixes a batch of GitHub issues in parallel worktrees through a background Workflow, one PR each, optionally merged on green CI.

plugins.name: npm-audit-fix
plugins.description: Clear npm audit findings per sub-project, honor allowlists, verify with project scripts, open one PR per sub-project.

plugins.name: postmortem-template
plugins.description: Write incident postmortems anchored to evidence, with trigger vs root cause, duration gaps and open questions.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Opens a pull request with a short body that says why, following strict writing rules: no test plan, no file lists, no dashes.

plugins.name: pr-address-comments
plugins.description: Pulls review comments on your PR, fixes what is actionable, and pushes, without ever writing to GitHub.

plugins.name: pre-ship-gate
plugins.description: Refuses commits and PRs that mix moves with logic, add dependencies, skip tests or are too big to review.

plugins.name: read-guard
plugins.description: Caps unbounded Reads of large files and tells Claude how to read the rest

plugins.name: release-version-bump
plugins.description: Cut a release for one project in a monorepo: sync, bump only if needed, tag with the CI tag prefix, push.

plugins.name: review-chain
plugins.description: Blocks the PR skill until code-review, ponytail-review and comment-cleanup have run in the session.

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Reviews someone else's pull request end to end and writes the review as a local draft file, never posted.

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Swaps secrets, emails and IPs in tool output and prompts for stable placeholders, and restores real values in tool inputs

plugins.name: smart-typecheck
plugins.description: After a turn that edited code, runs the check script once in each package that was touched

plugins.name: start
plugins.description: Pulls the default branch, cuts a named branch from your task description, and starts working on the task.

plugins.name: stop-check
plugins.description: Blocks the end of a turn while a changed JS/TS project fails its typecheck or related tests.

plugins.name: test-feature-locally
plugins.description: Verify a change end to end before a PR: bring up compose, start the dev server, drive the touched flow with Playwright.

plugins.name: text-lint
plugins.description: Refuses PR, issue and commit text with dashes, test plan sections, tables, hard wraps or features framed as fixes.

plugins.name: worktree-guard
plugins.description: Refuses edits in the main checkout while another Claude session works there, and points you to a worktree.
